overview: The commission approved multiple one-day liquor licenses and an entertainment license for the Great American Beer Hall, conditionally approved a new liquor and entertainment license for The Establishment at Rivers Edge, and reviewed a police incident report regarding a fight at Paco do Benfica.

items.title: Meeting Minutes Approval
items.summary: The commission approved the minutes of the August 21, 2024 meeting with minor language adjustments regarding Blue Fuji.

items.title: Special One-Day License: Event Dem Inc.
items.summary: The commission approved a one-day license for Event Dem Inc. for a video game tournament night on October 4.

items.title: Special One-Day License: Deep Cuts
items.summary: The commission approved a one-day license for Deep Cuts to serve beer and food at the Harvest Your Energy Festival behind the McGlynn School on October 19.

items.title: Special One-Day Licenses: Mary Queen of Peace Parish
items.summary: The commission approved two one-day licenses for Mary Queen of Peace Parish: one for a speed dating event on September 21 subject to hours and sketch submission, and another for a fall festival on September 28 subject to receiving insurance and a sketch.

items.title: Special One-Day Licenses: Tufts University
items.summary: The commission approved two one-day licenses for Tufts University, including a senior Oktoberfest event on October 5 and a wedding celebration at the Joyce Cummings Center on October 13.

items.title: Special One-Day License: Medford Chamber of Commerce
items.summary: The commission approved a one-day beer and wine license for the Medford Chamber of Commerce Oktoberfest on River Street on October 5, with a rain date of October 6.

items.title: Status Update and Entertainment License: Great American Beer Hall
items.summary: The commission heard a construction progress update regarding elevator inspection and approved an entertainment license covering performers, patrons, and devices.

items.title: New Liquor and Entertainment License Application: Establishment 2024 LLC
items.summary: The commission conditionally approved a new liquor license and entertainment license for Establishment 2024 LLC at 175 Rivers Edge Drive, pending submission of a finalized electronic and paper application packet.

items.title: Police Incident Report Review: Paco do Benfica
items.summary: The commission reviewed a police report regarding an August 27 fight between patrons and voted to place the report on file as a warning without further disciplinary action after learning both members were banned and staff cooperated fully.

items.title: Commission Discussion: D1 Soccer and General Updates
items.summary: Commissioners discussed upcoming annual compliance meetings and noted public safety and parking concerns related to potential future one-day license requests for D1 Soccer events at Hormel Stadium.
